results.query: In the cross-sectional pilot study of veterans, what cardiac MRI findings in people living with HIV suggested myocardial fibrosis and subclinical dysfunction?
results.answer: In a cross-sectional pilot study of veterans, higher growth differentiation factor (GDF)-15 blood levels, increased extracellular volume, and lower right heart function on MRI were found among patients with HIV, suggesting the presence of increased myocardial fibrosis and subclinical myocardial dysfunction in this population [PMID:41791688]. The study reports: "21 veterans with HIV (mean age 54 years; 71% White, 29% Black) and 20 controls (mean age 56 years; 70% White, 30% Black) were included." [PMID:41791688]. The study reports: "Multivariable linear regressions were used to investigate the associations. 21 veterans with HIV (mean age 54 years; 71% White, 29% Black) and 20 controls (mean age 56 years; 70% White, 30% Black) were included." [PMID:41791688].

results.query: In the single-arm DYNAMITE study, what structural changes were measured at 9 months and what major adverse cardiac events were observed by 24 months after DynamX implantation?
results.answer: The primary co-endpoints were the difference in mean device area and mean in-device lumen area from postprocedure to 9 months as measured by optical coherence tomography [PMID:41765253]. At 9-month follow-up, mean device area increased to 8.53 ± 1.71 mm² (absolute difference: 0.37 ± 0.99 mm²; relative difference: 5.52 ± 14.8%, p = 0.010), and mean in-device lumen area decreased to 7.57 ± 1.86 mm² (absolute difference: -0.70 ± 1.09 mm²; relative difference: -7.98 ± 14.9%, p <0.001) [PMID:41765253]. The study reports: "A total of 55 patients (55 lesions) were enrolled. Mean age was 67 ± 10 years, 7% (n = 4) were female, and 29% (n = 16) were diabetic." [PMID:41765253]. At 24-month follow-up, 4 patients (7.4%) experienced major adverse cardiac events, including one target vessel myocardial infarction and 4 target lesion revascularization events [PMID:41765253].

results.query: What evidence did the small HIV pilot provide for myocardial fibrosis and right-ventricular dysfunction, and what longitudinal question remains unanswered?
results.answer: The pilot study included 21 veterans with HIV (mean age 54 years; 71% White, 29% Black) and 20 controls (mean age 56 years; 70% White, 30% Black) [PMID:41791688]. Multivariable linear regressions were used to investigate the associations [PMID:41791688]. The study found higher growth differentiation factor (GDF)-15 blood levels, increased extracellular volume, and lower right heart function on MRI among patients with HIV [PMID:41791688]. These findings suggest the presence of increased myocardial fibrosis and subclinical myocardial dysfunction in this population [PMID:41791688]. Limited data from this pilot study suggest that HIV may be associated with increased cardiac fibrosis and decreased right ventricular function [PMID:41791688]. The study is cross-sectional and highlights the need for larger longitudinal studies to understand the trajectory of HIV-associated cardiac changes; it does not provide longitudinal data.

results.query: How was SCAR-Net built and validated for distinguishing postoperative breast scars from recurrent lesions, and how much did it change radiologist performance?
results.answer: SCAR-Net was developed using 34,376 ultrasound images from 5,710 patients across four hospitals, incorporating scar-recurrence feature enhancer and boundary-sensitive attention network modules [PMID:42023157]. The model was validated using a multicenter validation study design involving 34,376 ultrasound images from 5,710 patients across four hospitals [PMID:42023157]. In multicenter validation, SCAR-Net significantly improved radiologists' diagnostic performance, increasing AUC from 0.810-0.824 to 0.939-0.942, sensitivity from 0.775-0.782 to 0.934-0.941, and specificity from 0.839-0.872 to 0.935-0.950 (all p < 0.001) [PMID:42023157].

results.query: What target-specific tumor-localization evidence was reported for the LGR5 tracer [68Ga]Ga-LTP-02 and for the Nectin4 probes in their respective preclinical models?
results.answer: Saturation binding assays showed that [68Ga]Ga-LTP-02 exhibited higher binding affinity for LGR5 (Kd = 74.11 ± 24.52 nM) than [68Ga]Ga-LTP-01 (Kd = 153.40 ± 17.14 nM) [PMID:42000453]. Dynamic PET imaging revealed considerably higher uptake of [68Ga]Ga-LTP-02 in LGR5-positive A549 xenografts (4.74 ± 0.44 %ID/mL) than in LGR5-negative NCI-H1299 xenografts (0.98 ± 0.08 %ID/mL) [PMID:42000453]. Consistently, the tumor-to-muscle ratio was markedly higher in the A549 xenograft model (4.07 ± 0.07) than in the NCI-H1299 model (0.77 ± 0.10) [PMID:42000453]. Among them, [68Ga]Ga-LTP-02 exhibited superior sensitivity and specificity for detecting LGR5 expression and could effectively localize LGR5-positive tumors [PMID:42000453]. Cellular uptake assays demonstrated markedly higher accumulation of both tracers in MC38-Nectin4 cells (Nectin4+) compared with MC38 cells (Nectin4-negative, Nectin4-) [PMID:41916034]. In agreement with these results, biodistribution studies and PET imaging revealed pronounced and specific tracer accumulation in MC38-Nectin4 tumor models, whereas uptake in MC38 tumors remained substantially lower [PMID:41916034]. The tumor-to-muscle (T/M) ratio increased progressively over time and reached its maximum at 120 min post-injection (p.i.) [PMID:41916034]. Moreover, tumor uptake of [68Ga]Ga-NOTA-DN96 was consistently higher than that of [18F]AlF-NOTA-DN96 across all tumor models examined [PMID:41916034].

results.query: How did AI assistance change diagnostic performance in the simulated prostate-MRI triage workflow and in multicenter breast-ultrasound scar-versus-recurrence assessment?
results.answer: In the simulated prostate-MRI triage workflow involving MRI examinations of 500 men with suspected csPCa from four European centers, radiologists achieved a sensitivity of 89.4% (95% CI: 85.8, 93.1) and specificity of 57.7% (95% CI: 52.3, 63.1) [PMID:41960994]. The AI-driven pathway maintained comparable sensitivity (89.0%; 95% CI: 85.0, 93.0; P = .36) but improved specificity by 11.5%, reaching 69.2% (95% CI: 64.4, 74.0; P < .001) [PMID:41960994]. The AI system triaged and diagnosed 195 of 400 (49%; 95% CI: 173, 216) examinations with sensitivity of 94.7% (95% CI: 89.5, 99.9) and specificity of 94.7% (95% CI: 90.5, 98.9) [PMID:41960994]. The study reports: "Results Among the 400 patients (median age, 66 years; IQR, 60-69 years) included for testing, radiologists achieved a sensitivity of 89.4% (95% CI: 85.8, 93.1) and specificity of 57.7% (95% CI: 52.3, 63.1)." [PMID:41960994]. Using 34,376 ultrasound images from 5,710 patients across four hospitals, SCAR-Net significantly improved radiologists' diagnostic performance, increasing AUC from 0.810-0.824 to 0.939-0.942, sensitivity from 0.775-0.782 to 0.934-0.941, and specificity from 0.839-0.872 to 0.935-0.950 (all p < 0.001) [PMID:42023157].

results.query: What discrimination, sensitivity, and specificity did the catheter-related-thrombosis nomogram report in the oncology cohort?
results.answer: A nomogram integrating these variables demonstrated good discrimination (area under the curve = 0.866, 95% CI: 0.837-0.895), with a sensitivity of 70.33% and a specificity of 85.89% [PMID:42077124]. evidence.quote: A Bayesian approach to 2D acceleration for studying activation detection rate for simultaneously encoded slice acquisition in FMRI..
Traditional MRI methodologies require full k-space information, which follows a unique data acquisition sequence to reconstruct the complete image.
This process presents a time-consuming obstacle for medical imaging techniques.
Our study proposes a novel image reconstruction method to enhance the efficiency of data acquisition while maintaining high accuracy in activation detection.
The through-plane and in-plane acceleration techniques are combined to accelerate image acquisition along two dimensions.
Multiple image-shift strategies and a 2D Hadamard encoding scheme are used to increase encoding diversity and reduce slice leakage.

By applying our approach to both simulated and experimental fMRI data, we successfully reduced total scan time while achieving a higher signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) in regions of interest (ROI).

Compared with conventional reconstruction strategies, the proposed method demonstrates potential improvements in activation detection under specific acceleration and encoding conditions, while also providing voxel-wise estimates through a Bayesian framework.

results.query: In the retrospective vacuum-assisted-birth cohort, which factors were independently associated with assisted vaginal birth, and how did mid/low-pelvic applications differ from perineal applications?
results.answer: In a retrospective cohort of 3455 vaginal births (3090 spontaneous and 365 assisted), multivariable logistic regression identified maternal age (OR 1.04, 95% CI: 1.01-1.07), mode of conception (OR 1.58, 95% CI: 1.07-2.33), epidural analgesia (OR 6.25, 95% CI: 3.05-12.80), gestational age (OR 1.48, 95% CI: 1.31-1.67), and newborn male sex (OR 1.35, 95% CI: 1.06-1.73) as factors positively associated with assisted vaginal birth, whereas parity (OR 0.20, 95% CI: 0.14-0.29) was inversely associated [PMID:42036403]. Compared to perineal applications, mid/low pelvic vacuum applications were associated with greater blood loss (p < 0.01), higher episiotomy rate (95.5% vs 88.2%, p = 0.03), and increased ultrasound use (62.4% vs 23.5%, p < 0.01) [PMID:42036403].

results.query: In the prospective thoracic ASRT study, what did online adaptation change in target coverage and organ-at-risk dose, and what treatment-time and toxicity results were reported?
results.answer: Online adaptation significantly improved target coverage (median V100% change: +0.1%±2.5%) compared to predicted plans (-2.6%±7.3%, p < 0.001) [PMID:42058324]. The study reports: "A total of 41 patients were enrolled, receiving 232 fractions, of which 178 (76.7%) were treated with ASRT." [PMID:42058324]. Online adaptation resulted in no significant differences in organ-at-risk (OAR) doses [PMID:42058324]. The study reports: "Online adaptation significantly improved target coverage (median V100% change: +0.1%±2.5%) compared to predicted plans (-2.6%±7.3%, p < 0.001), without significant differences in OAR doses." [PMID:42058324]. Median total treatment time was 28 min, with an average 5-minute ASRT workflow [PMID:42058324]. No grade ≥ 3 toxicities were reported; grade 2 events occurred in 10.3% of patients [PMID:42058324].
